title: A Harvest for the Visitor
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Cyrus Yarrow, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
